answer: Only an unpaid, buyer-authorized text hash earns a bounty for counting crystal, quill and ivory. One key may submit unlimited parallel claims. A settlement contract recomputes signed counts: false counts are rejected without refunding prepaid computation costs; correct counts atomically consume the bounty. Changing keys adds no entitlement, even for colluders. Buyers funding padded copies undermine deduplication; corrupted settlement can double-pay. Human uniqueness remains untested.
